opening: In the annals of man, peace and strife are like the labors of the field: we must sow one to reap the other. Indeed, the Holy dynasty nursed the tranquil lands of the Hetmanate for five centuries, before Hetman Sokil the Holy's passing finally raised the bloody harvest moon. Verbenko the White, a good man in his own right, put on Sokil's crown, but he could not fill the legend's throne. The Hetmanate's nobles, sensing Verbenko's weakness, scoffed at their new liege lord and set about expanding their influence, leaving their Emperor to his wine cup and dancing girls. Verbenko's common subjects blamed him for his inability to rule and deplored his wanton habits; while the horrified populace watched, the once virtuous Verbenko the White decayed into the besotted Verbenko the Grey. Sensing that Verbenko's failing rule would spell disaster for the Hetmanate, a powerful noble, Kniaz Bronislaw of Black Forest, took up a new battle cry: "Chyhyryn is dying and Darkness is rising!" He rallied an army to his flag and marched on Chyhyryn, the Hetmanate's capital, gathering followers from all corners of the Hetmanate on his way. The Hetmanate entered the last phase of its existence, which historians later referred to as "The Rise of Darkness."

Naturally, Kniaz Bronislaw's rivals were not content to sit idle while his rebel army stormed Chyhyryn's walls. They quickly raised their own forces to protect their interests, and the last vestiges of Verbenko's authority vanished. Before long, lords from all of the Hetmanate's provinces had marched their armies to Chyhyryn, questing after the Hetman's seat. The squabbling nobles clashed ferociously, producing legions of casualties and heroes in equal measure. A chaotic new age had been born, and many, many anonymous warriors walked a path paved with iron...
I do not need to know why your path has led you here, adventurer. If you are ever to return, however, you must abide by our only rule: victory at any cost.

If you fail in a mission, you will spill your life's blood on the battlefield-- but it is our order as a whole which will suffer the greatest fate. Know also that if you are wounded while engaged in combat, you must stay strong: you may be quickly cured. You will not even be aware that you have been marred.
Choose your missions wisely. The means you employ are irrelevant, so long as the result is victory. Remember, a victorious mission is yours alone, but your failure is a defeat for all of us.
The Rise of Darkness has cast the entire land into chaos. Although we do not know what the future holds, we do know that your choices will lead inexorably to that future. Do not take them lightly.
We will meet again. Remember the golden rule: victory. You must somehow survive the end of this sad era to help forge the promise of the next! Godspeed, brave warrior.
